SENSEX AND NIFTY GAIN AS BANKING & IT SUPPORT RECOVERY

On 20 November 2026 the Sensex and Nifty 50 increased, driven by gains in banking and IT sectors. The market showed upward movement during the midday session.
The rise indicates a recovery momentum, with banking and IT strength underpinning broader market confidence.
